# Write a source-package support request that can be reproduced

A concise reproduction is more useful than a screenshot of the final error alone.

## Include the environment

State the package version, Xcode version, device or simulator, and the setup instructions you followed. Explain whether the failure occurs in an untouched copy or only after customization.

## Provide steps and expected behavior

Number the shortest sequence that reproduces the issue. Describe what you expected and what actually happened. Mention whether the behavior is consistent or intermittent.

## Share only relevant evidence

Include the first useful error message, a focused screenshot, or a small log excerpt. Remove passwords, tokens, personal data, and unrelated project details. Do not attach an entire paid source archive to a public issue.

## Separate observations from guesses

It is fine to propose a cause, but label it as a hypothesis. If you tried a workaround, record the exact change and its result. This lets the recipient test your observation rather than reverse-engineering a long series of unrelated edits.
